# v260 4-head adaptive composite target

- v96 opponent ranking is fixed; only ticket count is changed.
- N=2..20, exact 10,000-yen inverse-odds Dutch/Hamilton.
- POST probability split chooses between two composite-odds targets.
- Primary evidence is Feb-Jun; Jul/Aug are non-pristine secondary evidence.
- retrospective model-selection only.
